subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about funded-account acquisition for {Brand}. Since Chime posted its first GAAP profit in Q1 2026 on 25 percent revenue growth and 10.2 million active members, while SoFi presses on yields, the cost to win a funded depositor has tightened. US consumer-banking CAC now runs around $258 per customer, above investing and lending, and that real cost climbs once KYC drop-off and bonuses are counted. That spread is exactly where funded-event screening and a holdout decide your true cost per validated account. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: Chime Q1 2026 GAAP profit + SoFi competition (sourced) + US consumer-banking CAC band
